answer: An agent exchange for falcon tracking, onyx appraisal and karst mapping could cap subsidized bids per human sponsor. An independent enrollment service checks each person once and issues an anonymous credential. Every bid proves possession and reveals an epoch-specific nullifier, letting the exchange count all that sponsor's agents against one quota without exposing their name. Extra keys gain no extra quota; an attacker must recruit real people or corrupt enrollment. Credential rental and exclusion of people without documents remain weaknesses.
